ac:layout-cell.p: Logical Feature Specification · Sequence and Reuse Assessment · Feature landing page

This separate companion set reorganises SPEC-SEI-007 for stakeholder, business-process and engineering review. It adds the supplied FR sending-guide assessment. The predecessor stays unchanged, including its detailed contracts, data inventory and field traceability. OUT activity, requirement and acceptance IDs retain their meanings.

ERP issuance ownership and independent action outcomes remain unchanged. The current journey sends one invoice for a business or its authorised accountant. PRD-SEI-246 now records the local-product transitional PDF responsibility; exact channel coverage and issuance/copy coordination remain open. SPEC-SEI-022 is selected for the existing Confluence page 923861395. The logical specification and sequence/reuse assessment are companion pages under the same feature. Publication is authorised; all three lifecycle statuses remain draft.

A Spanish business or authorised accountant must prepare an invoice, resolve blocking issues and send the exact final invoice through a qualified route. The ERP owns issuance. The product must show what happened to each delivery or required public copy and who must act next.

This summary is for Product, directors and cross-functional stakeholders. SPEC-SEI-023 owns the proposed behaviour in this set. SPEC-SEI-024 assesses existing APIs and evidence gaps. REF-BASE; REF-PRODUCT.

Use the shared glossary. The represented business, authenticated caller, invoice seller/buyer, approver and signer are distinct roles. Login, connection and certificate possession do not by themselves establish action authority.

An exchange action has one purpose and result, such as recipient delivery or faithful public-copy submission. A processing notification or technical acknowledgement does not establish buyer acceptance.

tr.td: Direct business or accountant for one client
Prepare, approve where authorised and send one invoice with current business/action authority.
Service-assisted draft entry and validation — TBC
Confirm scope and handoff. The proposed path returns issues before issuance; correction creates a new draft revision.
Final candidate ready
Qualify its exact data, recipient route, files, authority and required actions before dependent issuance.
Public or private recipient route
Select one eligible delivery route from current evidence. Apply Spain copy rules separately.
Already-issued invoice or uncertain action
Preserve issuance and earlier results. Use the applicable correction or reconciliation path.
Transitional PDF required
The local product generates the matching PDF. Recipient delivery uses a separately qualified capability and owner. See OUT-PDF-R01/02.

ac:layout-cell.p: An accountant sending one client's invoice uses the same route and copy controls as the business user. Batch sending is not a prerequisite, and the supplied FR guide does not establish a bulk accountant requirement. Wider portfolio and accounting-handoff proposals stay separate under OUT-Q02.

Full setup belongs to onboarding. Creation, trust, route qualification and later lifecycle reporting retain their owning specifications. This sending set coordinates their handoffs; it does not approve new service boundaries. REF-BASE; REF-PRODUCT.

The main decision is the recipient route. Private delivery has a separate faithful public-copy action; public recipient delivery has no extra copy. The same single-invoice flow applies to a business user or an authorised accountant. The diagram shows these actions separately so one result cannot hide another. REF-LOGICAL; SPFE-S02 Article 4.

The red dashed box keeps service-assisted draft entry, preparation and validation TBC. Final candidates and qualified already-issued invoices still need current authority, final validation and an eligible route. A failed lookup holds dispatch; it cannot select public fallback.

The ERP owns issuance. Coordinate any required public copy with issuance under OUT-Q03. Recipient delivery and public-copy results stay independent; technical success does not establish buyer acceptance. OUT-SPFE-R01; SPFE-S02 Article 4; OUT-13–15.

PDF responsibility: the local product generates the transitional readable PDF where the product rule applies. Send it to the recipient, never to the public platform. A qualified private attachment path may carry it; the public structured-invoice route needs a separate recipient PDF channel. SEI023 defines behaviour; SEI024 assesses upload and delivery. RD238-T2.
SEI023 retains the process and activity order, exception and recovery decisions, Spain rules and scenario checks. Recovery preserves successful actions and resolves only affected work.

tr.td: Shared design patterns
Retain revision binding, independent action results, approval evidence and recovery. Reusing these patterns does not prove existing code coverage.
FR sending APIs
Assess the documented create/upload/event/detail flow first. It starts with prepared files; it does not establish the complete draft-to-issuance Spain journey. INT-SND01; SPEC-SEI-024.
Shared capability with country binding
Qualify identity, addresses, document/profile selection, route evidence, trust and status mappings for the selected Spain route.
Transformation
Existing DTS is the preferred candidate. Qualify its build, Spain mappings, rule packs, semantic preservation and operations under SPEC-SEI-008. REF-DTS.
Spain-specific behaviour
Public recipient fallback, faithful copies and legal correction rules stay in Spain policy. Public transport and format evidence do not establish a ready Sage integration. SPFE-S02/S08/S16.
Unknown implementation
Preparation/final handoffs, copy/issuance coordination, per-action results, approval and portfolio coverage need named owners and evidence before activation.
Service-assisted draft entry and validation — TBC
ERP Product, API and Architecture must confirm the scope, owner and draft-to-final handoff before enabling this path.
OUT-Q01 Approval policy
Product, Identity and Spain Compliance must qualify eligible roles, manual/automatic decisions and revision binding. Missing evidence holds the dependent action.
OUT-Q03 Issuance and public-copy coordination
ERP, E-Invoice and Compliance owners must prove the actual boundary and partial/lost-result recovery. A saved queue intent alone is insufficient.
Route and trust qualification
Routing, Integration, Identity and Trust owners must supply fresh eligible route evidence and selected-purpose authority. An unresolved lookup cannot select public delivery by default.
FR contract and Spain coverage
API and Integration owners must pin the actual schemas/build, country fields, representation support, idempotency and event meanings. Existing FR documentation is insufficient for activation.
Transitional PDF delivery channel

Local Product, API, Integration and Compliance must qualify attachment or separate-channel recipient delivery. The existing attachment API is a reuse candidate; actual Spain support and delivery proof remain open under SND-G08.
OUT-Q02 Portfolio and accounting handoff
Separate optional scope; not required for the main single-invoice journey. Qualify it before enabling it.

ac:layout-cell.p: The business can see a separate known result or owned pending/unknown state for each action. An escalation or notification alone cannot close the invoice journey. Functional acceptance is in SPEC-SEI-023; engineering qualification is in SPEC-SEI-024. These drafts do not establish production readiness.
